title: "I Recall the Past": Exploring How People Collaborate with Generative AI to Create Cultural Heritage Narratives

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative workshops where 20 participants used Stable Diffusion to generate images of familiar and unfamiliar cultural heritage sites, followed by thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews, user prompts, and the generated images to identify Western architectural defaults, cultural stereotypes, and deviations from authentic cultural representations.
